car.name: Wispwing 660 1993
car.description: Original logo-free 2994 lilac and mustard tiny mid-engine fixed-roof coupe with closed gullwing doors. JDM January 1993 Cara five-speed manual RHD inspiration, not a retractable roadster. Exact Suzuki source units preserved; unknown limiter and differential explicitly estimated.

catalogProvenance.inspiration: JDM January1993 Suzuki Cara base E-PG6SS FAXF, mid-engine RWD five-speed manual, RHD, fixed-roof two-seat gullwing coupe, doors closed

sources.kind: Official Suzuki digital-library historical technical table
fields: Actual single-page PDF downloaded, text extracted, rendered to oem-table.png and visually inspected. Header explicitly January1993, E-PG6SS, FAXF, five-speed manual.
OEM description confirms Mazda-built AZ-1-derived supply model, Suzuki F6A engine, engine behind driver and rear-wheel drive.

estimates: Actual official Suzuki January 1993 Cara E-PG6SS FAXF technical table personally inspected. Exact 5MT ratios and 4.705 final retained, not substituted Mazda/Cappuccino ratios. Fixed-roof closed gullwing coupe; no roof-state simulation.

64 PS converted to mechanical hp with .986320070619; 8.7 kgf-m converted with 9.80665 Nm/kgf-m then 1.3558179483314004 Nm/lb-ft. Published kW/Nm cells blank: derived values not independently published. Power 6500 rpm, torque 4000 rpm, 657 cc intercooled turbo.

720 kg OEM vehicle mass, detailed fluid/driver convention undefined; not dry mass and no driver mass adjustment. Exact dimensions, tracks, 155/65R13 and 30 L tank retained. Nominal .26585m geometric tire radius, loaded radius unknown.

7000 redline, 7500 cutoff, 900 idle, .7 bar boost, full torque curve/boost schedule, .43 front fraction, CG .42m, Cd .35, steering ratio16, overhang/cabin split, 40 US mpg, 90 mph/11 sec display and handling/brake/shift/launch parameters are simulation estimates. No verified 8500 rpm or 140 km/h limiter. Differential 0/0 is an estimate; no factory LSD claimed.

Original RHD dashboard: shared runtime steering wheel and upper-opening gauges fitted to right binnacle. Fixed rear camera; surface tire smoke/spray. Cara/AZ-1 family counted once, not badge siblings.
